scripts.build: npm run build:csv && npm run build:xlsx && npm run build:html
scripts.build:csv: nextsheet build sheets/Invoices.sheet.tsx sheets/Clients.sheet.tsx --target csv --out dist/workbook.csv
scripts.build:xlsx: nextsheet build sheets/Invoices.sheet.tsx sheets/Clients.sheet.tsx --target xlsx --out dist/workbook.xlsx
scripts.build:html: nextsheet build sheets/Invoices.sheet.tsx sheets/Clients.sheet.tsx --target html --out dist/index.html
